proof_attempt_summary: Derived a normalization-budget threshold, matched subcritical full-boundary risk and honest-width rates, supercritical nonlearning, and a critical bracket with polynomial exponent envelopes. Corrected all affected control-arm identities to F_0=3r/d and independently audited the delivered closure as mathematically sound; the exact critical rate remains unresolved. The resulting fixed-rectangle sectionwise theorem is subfield-tier and does not meet the field floor; no Lean formalization was launched.
tldr: On a fixed rectangular assignment boundary under sectionwise signed-distance access, a public \(C^\beta\) density-modulus budget induces a sharp design-mass phase transition. The density-class threshold calculation proves a common boundary-density floor exactly when \(H<H_\star(B)\). In that subcritical regime, full-boundary minimax risk and honest connected-band half-width have order \((n\log n)^{-1/4}\), while fixed corner-excluded edges have the faster density-indexed frontier. For \(H>H_\star(B)\), uniform learning fails even with full coordinates. At \(H=H_\star(B)\), both criteria remain consistent but their exact sequences are open: \(c n^{-\gamma_\beta}\le\mathcal R_n(B),\mathcal W_n(B)\le C(\log n/n)^{1/5}\), with \(\gamma_\beta=2/9\) for \(\beta\le1/2\) and \(2(1+\beta)/(11+5\beta)\) otherwise. The elbow at \(\beta=1/2\) comes from the competing curvature and density-modulus cutoffs in the angular-hole experiment. Risk and honest width have the same lower and upper polynomial decay exponents, but the common exponent and logarithmic factors are not determined.
gap: Cattaneo--Titiunik--Yu studies distance-based boundary effects and geometric irregularities, but its linked-distance simultaneous calibration and support-changing converse do not settle a fixed-rectangle sectionwise experiment. The accepted unrestricted-density frontier is a substantive existing converse, while fixed-tip centroid correction is already available. Neither supplies the density-modulus full-curve upper bound.
fill: The proposal derives the design-mass threshold, establishes a legal corner converse on the fixed support, and isolates the arbitrary-weight representer and localized supremum obligations for an attaining sectionwise procedure. A separate uniform edge theorem identifies the precision gain from fixed corner exclusion.
